page_summary: This section outlines key recommendations for ports to enhance cybersecurity and resilience. It emphasizes the importance of conducting asset inventories, regular risk assessments, implementing practical risk mitigation measures, developing business continuity plans, and regularly testing these plans through exercises. By integrating cybersecurity into established processes, ports can strengthen their resilience without creating parallel frameworks.

regions.description: Details on the importance of identifying key systems and processes in ports.

regions.label: Recommendation 2: Conduct regular risk assessments
regions.description: Guidance on conducting risk assessments at planned intervals.

regions.label: Recommendation 3: Implement practical risk mitigation measures
regions.description: Advice on system protection and accountability in cybersecurity.

regions.label: Recommendation 4: Develop a business continuity plan
regions.description: Encouragement for ports to create and update business continuity plans.

regions.label: Recommendation 5: Regularly test the business continuity plans through exercise drills
